title: Infrastructure Manager (m/w/d) for AI Ops Implementation
description:
Shape the Future of Financial Services with Capco

At Capco, we specialize in management consulting and software development, partnering with leading international banks and insurance companies across Western Europe. Our innovative approach and collaborative culture make us the ideal place for professionals looking to make an impact in financial services technology.

Role Description

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Infrastructure Manager (m/w/d) to lead a major AI Ops implementation project for a large German bank. The ideal candidate combines strong technical infrastructure expertise with proven experience in managing complex IT projects, leading technical teams, and coordinating stakeholders in large-scale enterprise environments.

This role requires a hands-on understanding of modern IT infrastructure, automation, and operational processes, alongside strong project leadership, communication, and organizational skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and coordinate a large-scale AI Ops implementation project, ensuring effective planning, execution, and alignment with business and technical objectives.
  • Manage and coordinate cross-functional IT teams responsible for setting up, integrating, and managing complex infrastructure environments.
  • Oversee infrastructure-related activities across networking, virtualization, containerization, and cloud technologies.
  • Ensure the implementation aligns with existing IT architecture, operational processes, and enterprise infrastructure standards.
  • Oversee the consideration of functional and non-functional requirements, including performance, security, availability, and operational stability.
  • Manage dependencies, technical risks, and implementation challenges across different teams and workstreams.
  • Act as a key interface between technical teams, project stakeholders, and management, ensuring transparent communication and alignment.
  • Drive collaboration in ITIL-based, DevOps, and agile delivery environments.
  • Establish structured project governance, track progress, and ensure timely delivery of key milestones.

Skills and Expertise

  • Solid experience in managing IT teams in setting up and managing complex environments in large-scale IT projects in a banking environment.
  • Experience in managing IT infrastructure, networking, virtualization, containerization, and cloud technologies.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies, and test automation.
  • Understanding of both functional and non-functional test requirements (e.g., performance, security, availability).
  • Proficient in stakeholder communication and program leadership.
  • Experience working in ITIL-based, DevOps, or agile project environments.
  • High degree of ownership and structured work approach.
  • Ability to clearly communicate complex technical topics in both German and English.
